globalAttributes.name: fill
globalAttributes.description: Flex fill weight in a box slot. Bare `fill` = 1; `fill="2"` grows twice as much.

globalAttributes.name: gap
globalAttributes.description: Gap between children (px if unitless). Sets `--widget-gap`.

globalAttributes.name: halign
globalAttributes.description: Horizontal alignment (box justify/align, or overlay child).

globalAttributes.name: valign
globalAttributes.description: Vertical alignment (box justify/align, or overlay child).

globalAttributes.name: anchors
globalAttributes.description: Canvaspanel child anchors (UE-style). Named presets or `minX,minY,maxX,maxY` in 0-1.

globalAttributes.name: top
globalAttributes.description: Canvas offset from top (px if unitless).

globalAttributes.name: left
globalAttributes.description: Canvas offset from left (px if unitless).

globalAttributes.name: right
globalAttributes.description: Canvas offset from right (px if unitless).

globalAttributes.name: bottom
globalAttributes.description: Canvas offset from bottom (px if unitless).

globalAttributes.name: kind
globalAttributes.description: Optional style variant hook used by demo / theme CSS.

tags.name: horizontalbox
tags.description: UMG Horizontal Box, lays out children in a row (flex).

tags.name: verticalbox
tags.description: UMG Vertical Box, lays out children in a column (flex).

tags.name: wrapbox
tags.description: UMG Wrap Box, horizontal flow that wraps to the next line.

tags.name: overlay
tags.description: UMG Overlay, stacks children in one cell. Use child `halign` / `valign`. Last child paints on top.

tags.name: canvaspanel
tags.description: UMG Canvas Panel, absolute children with `anchors` and `top`/`left`/`right`/`bottom` offsets. (`<canvas>` is reserved by HTML.)

tags.name: scrollbox
tags.description: UMG Scroll Box, clips to allocated size and scrolls overflow. Needs `height` or a `fill` slot.

attributes.name: drag-scroll
attributes.description: Click-drag to scroll (mouse/pen). Overrides configure({ dragScroll }). Use drag-scroll="false" to opt out.

tags.name: sizebox
tags.description: UMG Size Box, forces child to the box size.

tags.name: scalebox
tags.description: UMG Scale Box, scales the first child to fit the box.

tags.name: gridpanel
tags.description: UMG Grid Panel. Equal columns by default; `masonry` packs uneven heights; `uniform` equal `1fr` rows×columns.

attributes.name: rows
attributes.description: Row count. Used with `uniform` (default 2); optional equal rows without `uniform`. Ignored for `masonry`.

attributes.name: masonry
attributes.description: Boolean. Multi-column pack for uneven child heights (column-first flow).

attributes.name: uniform
attributes.description: Boolean. Equal `1fr` columns and rows (same as the `uniformgridpanel` tag).

tags.name: uniformgridpanel
tags.description: UMG Uniform Grid Panel alias for `<gridpanel uniform>`. Equal `1fr` columns and rows.

tags.name: spacer
tags.description: UMG Spacer, flexible empty space that absorbs leftover room in a box.

tags.name: border
tags.description: UMG Border, chrome + padding around content. Flex column so a `[fill]` child can take remaining height.

tags.name: safezone
tags.description: UMG Safe Zone, pads with `env(safe-area-inset-*)` for notches / home indicators.

tags.name: widgetswitcher
tags.description: UMG Widget Switcher, shows the child whose `page` (or `data-page`) matches `active`.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Id of the visible child page.

tags.name: namedslot
tags.description: UMG Named Slot, light-DOM placeholder for injected content. Use `name` to identify the slot.

tags.name: retainerbox
tags.description: UMG Retainer Box, API-parity passthrough (no offscreen render cache in the browser).

tags.name: invalidationbox
tags.description: UMG Invalidation Box, API-parity passthrough (no layout/paint cache in the browser).

tags.name: backgroundblur
tags.description: UMG Background Blur, empty (or sparse) layer that blurs content behind it via `backdrop-filter`. Stack under chrome in an `overlay`; do not wrap the modal content.

tags.name: textblock
tags.description: UMG Text Block, static text. Prefer `text="..."` attribute.

tags.name: image
tags.description: UMG Image, brush / tint rectangle.

attributes.name: brush
attributes.description: Image URL or CSS image value (`url(...)`, gradients).

tags.name: progressbar
tags.description: UMG Progress Bar, display-only bar driven by `percent` (0-100).

tags.name: checkbox
tags.description: UMG Check Box, click / Space / Enter toggles `checked`. Fires `changed`.

tags.name: slider
tags.description: UMG Slider, drag or arrows to set `percent` (0-100). Fires `percentchanged`.

tags.name: editabletext
tags.description: UMG Editable Text, contenteditable. Syncs `text`. Enter commits (unless `multiline`).

attributes.name: multiline
attributes.description: Allow newlines; Enter does not commit.

tags.name: button
tags.description: Native button. Add the `widget` attribute for UMG-style chrome from widget.css.
